'use client' import { useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react' import { useGSAP } from '@/lib/hooks/useGSAP' import { prefersReducedMotion, useReducedMotion } from './useReducedMotion' export type StaggerProps = { children: ReactNode className?: string selector?: string trigger?: 'mount' | 'scroll' stagger?: number distance?: number duration?: number delay?: number ease?: string once?: boolean } export function Stagger({ children, className, selector, trigger = 'scroll', stagger = 0.1, distance = 24, duration = 0.6, delay = 0, ease = 'power2.out', once = true, }: StaggerProps) { const root = useRef(null) const reduced = useReducedMotion() useGSAP( ({ gsap }) => { const element = root.current if (!element || reduced || prefersReducedMotion()) return const items = selector ? gsap.utils.toArray(selector, element) : Array.from(element.children) if (items.length === 0) return gsap.from(items, { autoAlpha: 0, y: distance, duration, delay, stagger, ease, clearProps: 'transform,opacity,visibility', scrollTrigger: trigger === 'scroll' ? { trigger: element, start: 'top 85%', toggleActions: once ? 'play none none none' : 'play none none reverse', once, } : undefined, }) }, [delay, distance, duration, ease, once, reduced, selector, stagger, trigger], root, ) return (
{children}
) }
